cards.name: form_valid
cards.spec: form_valid(self, form) calls create_sale(customer, number, date) from sales.services with form.cleaned_data values. create_sale already saves the Sale, so NEVER call super().form_valid or form.save(). The new sale's total is always 0.00 (posted total is ignored; tests must not assert it). create_sale raises ValueError only for an inactive customer: then form.add_error(None, str(e)) and return self.form_invalid(form) (status 200, no Sale). On success return redirect('sales:list').
